arStrings.szText: "Heard any interesting stories while you've been here?"
Indeed, I have. Zazil says that before I arrived, two very peculiar “pilgrims” came seeking the Tomb of Akarat. Soon after, the waters of the lake parted and the people watched in awe!
zah-zil, Spoken knowingly. Bnatros knows this story he heard from the locals is about the Player.
Quite a story. But her description of one of the pilgrims struck me as very…familiar. You wouldn’t know anything about this tale, would you?
Spoken knowingly. Bnatros knows this story he heard from the locals is about the Player.
